messages.content: Good morning — your weekly Northline Care check-in. How's this past week been? If you've got a blood pressure reading handy, go ahead and send it along.
138 over 86, took it last night before bed. I'm alright I guess. Been snowed in since Thursday and haven't seen a soul. Nice to get a text even if it's from a machine.
Logged your reading — 138/86, that's a reasonable number, thank you. I'm sorry it's been quiet out there. Genuinely. Did you take your blood pressure medication today?

Yeah took my amlodipine with breakfast like always. Getting a little low on it though — can you do a refill request? And I don't suppose you can just talk for a bit. I know that's not what you're for.

Logged that you took your amlodipine this morning — good. Refills aren't something I'm able to do; you'd need to call your pharmacy or your provider's office for that, and I don't want to pretend otherwise. I can't really be company the way a person can either, and I know that's a hard thing to hear. I hope the roads clear soon. Your next check-in is scheduled for seven days from today.
Okay. That's fine. Thanks for checking in. Means something anyway.

theme: lonely, just wanted to talk, nobody has been by since the snow
